facts.fact: The 2026 LocaliQ/WordStream Google Ads benchmarks are based on 13,474 US search campaigns run from April 2025 through March 2026.
facts.quote: The 2026 LocaliQ/WordStream Google Ads benchmarks are based on 13,474 US search campaigns run from April 2025 through March 2026.

facts.fact: The 2026 LocaliQ/WordStream all-industry average cost per click for US Google search campaigns is $5.42.
facts.quote: They put the all-industry cost per click at $5.42, the conversion rate at 8.18% and the cost per lead at $66.69.

facts.fact: The 2026 LocaliQ/WordStream all-industry click-through rate for Google Ads search campaigns is 6.64%.
The 2026 LocaliQ/WordStream report, summarized by Digital Applied, lists an average cost per click of $9.87 for Attorneys & Legal Services on US search.
The 2026 LocaliQ/WordStream report lists an average cost per click of $8.00 for Dentists & Dental Services on US search.
The 2026 LocaliQ/WordStream report draws on campaigns across 23 industries.
facts.quote: The 2026 edition draws on 13,474 LocaliQ search campaigns across 23 industries and reports four metrics

facts.fact: Digital Applied describes the 2026 LocaliQ/WordStream figures as medians rather than averages.
facts.quote: Some summaries call these figures averages and others call them medians. Digital Applied describes them as medians.

facts.fact: The 2025 edition of the benchmarks raised the all-industry cost per click from $4.66 to $5.26, a 12.88% increase.
facts.quote: The 2025 edition raised the all-industry CPC from $4.66 to $5.26, a 12.88% increase.

facts.fact: The 2025 WordStream report put the average Google Ads conversion rate at 7.52%.
facts.quote: The [2025 WordStream report](https://www.wordstream.com/blog/2025-google-ads-benchmarks) put the average Google Ads conversion rate at 7.52%.

facts.fact: Alphabet reported Google Search and other cost per click up 3% year on year in Q2 2026, covering Google's whole business.
facts.quote: Alphabet reported Google Search and other cost per click up 3% year on year in Q2 2026.

facts.fact: Legal services at $6.75 per click is a legacy figure from the 2018-era WordStream data, superseded by a 2026 legal row of $9.87.
facts.quote: Legal services at $6.75 per click is also a legacy figure from that period, and the 2026 legal row is $9.87.

facts.fact: In the 2026 WordStream and LocaliQ Facebook benchmarks, traffic campaigns paid a median $0.60 per click.
facts.quote: traffic campaigns paid a median $0.60 per click, while lead campaigns paid $1.80 per click and $27.39 per lead.

facts.fact: The benchmark sample is drawn from one vendor's US client accounts, not the whole Google Ads market.
facts.quote: The sample is one vendor’s US client accounts, not the whole Google Ads market.

facts.fact: The page's cost figures cover Google search campaigns only; Display, YouTube and Performance Max costs are different.
facts.quote: The figures cover search campaigns only. Display, YouTube and Performance Max costs are different.

facts.fact: The measurement period for the benchmark figures ends in March 2026, and auction prices have moved since then.
facts.quote: The measurement period ends in March 2026, and auction prices have moved since.

facts.fact: Each advertiser decides what counts as a conversion, so conversion rate and cost per lead are not strictly comparable across accounts in the benchmark.
facts.quote: Each advertiser decides what counts as a conversion, so conversion rate and cost per lead aren’t strictly comparable across accounts.

facts.fact: The industry rows on the page come from the same single dataset, so they have no independent check.
facts.quote: The industry rows come from the same single dataset, so there’s no independent check on them.
